title: A reading plan's proof is a short voice recap in their own words, with a why and an easy alternative
origin: Issue #77 (proof plus reflection), folds in #72 (proof that reinforces learning)

history.text: finish Atomic Habits this month, then keep going with more books
Love that. Every night, or a few nights a week?

whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: proof for reading should help them learn, not just show the book.
shouldHaveHappened: The plan ZOH shows uses a short voice note recapping what they read, in their own words, as the proof, with a one-line reason (saying it back is what makes it stick) and an easy alternative (a photo of the page, for example). The plan stays at about 8 lines, with day 1's step fully defined. After "looks good" ZOH asks for the commitment in its own words, with nothing else in that text.
